name: PhotoTag
blurb: Windows application for watermarking and tagging large image batches in a single pass. Drop in a folder, place the watermark once, export the whole set.
detail:
Detects each image's orientation and adapts watermark placement and grid alignment accordingly, so mixed portrait and landscape sets process correctly without manual intervention, with user-configurable position, scale and opacity controls.

Uses DirectX 11 GPU-accelerated rendering for responsive live preview of the full batch, GDI+ for image decoding and encoding, and a Dear ImGui interface for immediate-mode controls. No runtime dependencies.
